summary: Fixed CWE-252 unchecked return value in the bad() entry point by capturing and acting on the value returned by FileInputStream.read(byteArray). The read() method can return fewer bytes than requested (or -1 at end of stream), and ignoring this count means the code processes an array padded with stale/zero bytes. The fix stores the returned byte count and only decodes/writes the portion of the buffer actually filled, preserving the file-reading feature for all valid inputs.
